We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Support statutory reporting including new product setting, data preparation, model run design, result review and communication.
  • Support reinsurance administration tasks, including system, maintenance and submission which involves extensive regulatory data systems reporting (EAST, PRIS etc.) and various ad-hoc regulatory reporting requirement
  • Coordinate related new product system testing, reinsurance administration system testing which is critical to business.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • ASA or close to ASA, with at least 4 years’ actuarial experience.
  • On-hands actuarial experience in financial reporting and actuarial modelling,
  • Good communication skills in both oral and written

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited

ln:4454531337.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Software Engineer.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Job ID:56148

Principal Responsibilities

  • Deliver AEM-related front-end development and componentisation (page/template/component development, front-end engineering practices, performance optimisation and maintainability improvements).
  • Design and develop Spring Boot microservices, including REST API design, business logic implementation, exception handling, logging and observability integration.
  • Participate in application deployment and runtime optimisation on AWS and Kubernetes (containerisation, configuration management, environment handling, capacity and performance tuning).
  • Collaborate with Product, Business, Architecture, QA, Operations/SRE and Security to drive requirement clarification, technical solution reviews and delivery execution.
  • Write and maintain database scripts, data-fix scripts and automation scripts to support releases and rapid production troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to code reviews, unit testing and CI practices to improve engineering quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Respond quickly to production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and drive long-term fixes and preventive actions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software development experience with strong end-to-end delivery capability and solid engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on AEM front-end development experience with a good understanding of AEM component-based development and front-end best practices; able to deliver pages/components independently and optimise them.
  • Spring Boot microservices development experience; familiar with common microservices patterns, API design, and foundational capabilities such as authentication/authorisation, exception handling and logging.
  • Solid cloud-native fundamentals: working knowledge of core AWS services and architecture concepts; basic Kubernetes capability (deployment, service discovery, configuration and troubleshooting).
  • Strong database skills: proficient in relational databases (e.g., MySQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL) with data modelling and SQL; able to write release/rollback/data-fix scripts.
  • Scripting capability (Shell/Python, etc.) to support automation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: able to articulate technical solutions and risks clearly, and work effectively across teams to drive closure.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: able to diagnose issues under pressure, propose actionable solutions, and drive continuous improvement through post-incident reviews.

/WX/51

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

ln:4460220603.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Summary

This role supports Global Process Owner (GPO), Coverage to manage client lifecycle processes for CIB business. The role sits within first line of defence responsible for adherence to Bank’s policies & procedures, risk management, operational excellence, and governance applicable to the business function.

Key Responsibilities

To support the Global Process Owner / Delegates in executing accountability over process through:

  • Being responsible for the process(es) managed on behalf of the Global Process Owner / Delegate
  • Support Process Owner responsibilities at each stage of the RCSA, from new process and risk identification through to monitoring implement controls, on a minimum of an annual basis or when a trigger event occurs (e.g., a change in control effectiveness)
  • Support ensuring all agreed elevated residual risk actions and treatment plans are completed in a timely manner by all action owners, and logged into the Group OR management system
  • Understand Agile delivery impact on the process: identify risks and dependencies, assess impact on critical processes and residual risk.
  • Discuss, review and approve Change Risk Assessments (where required) and any process impact assessment ahead of change initiatives go-lives, including for “minor” change initiatives

Strategy

  • Responsible for supporting end to end management of CIB, Coverage process governance, risk / controls and regulatory requirements.

Business

  • Work closely with stakeholders internally & externally, including hubs, and across the CIB network to drive a common understanding of policies, procedures and processes.
  • Provide inputs to Policy Owners & Business/Operations while drafting policies & standards as part of Consultation.
  • Engage with Business, Risk Managers, Client Management Heads, Execution Teams and Operations as key stakeholders to build synergy between the regions and countries, share best practices and ensure uniform approach towards implementation of any Global process changes, and adherence to DOIs.
  • Develop operational guidance for issuance to the network as part of any implementation/process change and work with country process owners across CIB to develop training plans & materials across the value chain and prepare the network to implement & support any process change.
  • Conduct Business Performance Reviews to assess effectiveness of execution of the processes.
  • Participate in Coverage Triage to review incoming Business Initiatives and accept changes into the backlog, as appropriate.
  • Refine the process backlog leveraging agile principles including pipeline prioritisation and tracking of initiatives in a timely manner.
  • Where a process gap is identified, perform the gap analysis, design the solution and work with system POs (as applicable), to raise the business requirements.
  • Review the user stories or process improvement suggestions developed for systems, to ensure they capture the business requirements accurately
  • Identify enhancements to improve Client Lifecycle processes/efficiency and/or reduce risk in line with Group Policy and Procedures

Processes

  • Manage end to end Process Governance including revising existing processes and rolling out new ones
  • Work closely with relevant committees, operational risk heads and risk managers to continuously enhance the quality of the guidance issued to the network based on feedback and thematic issues identified through the QA/ RRA processes
  • Work closely with the systems team to identify areas of potential automation
  • Support functional design, testing and deployment of change initiatives
  • Develop a detailed understanding of all areas within the process supported
  • Assist with the roll-out of improved processes and practices, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), User Verification Test (UVT), and BAU Change deployment, as required
  • Manage and engage key stakeholders across client facing divisions, product teams , relevant 2 LOD functions, etc
  • Input into & lead as required relevant squads/working groups
  • Provide subject matter expertise for processes and data managed to support Client Lifecycle BAU and change initiatives
  • Embed new policy and processes into BAU after effectively engage the network

People & Talent

  • Point of contact for resolution of process issues for the processes supported
  • Manage initiatives to improve processes and resolve high profile issues
  • Display strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills on a daily basis in the implementation of process improvements and risk management.
  • Collaborate with other members of the team to ensure governance and coverage of key risk areas and implement the required controls.

Risk Management

  • Timely and effective delivery of reports on regulatory responses and audit management
  • Work closely with Compliance, Legal & Operational Risk teams to ensure deliverables are aligned with the latest requirements & regulations, and any exceptions are appropriately escalated, reported and managed
  • Highlight risks to management and actively monitor them to reduce the likelihood of occurrence. Ongoing control monitoring of the minimum control requirements set out in the policy and procedures to ensure that if a key control activity stops working, or operates outside its normal operating conditions, it will be quickly detected in the ordinary course of line management
  • Attend service review meetings & challenge as necessary to report risk status.
  • Help determine if there are any overlaps & inputs into other processes and/or risk registers
  • Help ensure process risks are identified, escalated & tracked to resolution

Governance

  • Documentation of relevant analysis artefacts as required with Client Life Cycle governance
  • Act as liaison between the 2LoD and the various business or execution teams for effective and efficient process governance.
  • Weighs up benefits of short term tactical and long-term strategic options to ensure solutions are delivered to the appropriate scale, scope and timing

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the teams to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles. Fair Outcome for the Clients, Financial Crime Compliance and Right Environment
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Client Coverage RMT and CMT
  • Operations/Processing Teams
  • Product functions and teams
  • Country Teams
  • Risk & Control functions
  • CIB Data
  • Group CFCR
  • Group Legal
  • Group Operational Risk

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Coverage Operations
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;

Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma qualified with relevant experience in multiple phases of the programme and change management, preferably with exposure to business project delivery roles
  • Knowledge of client onboarding, client lifecycle business areas aligned with corporate and commercial banking
  • Knowledge of SCB standard processes, project management, implementation and post implementation process is an advantage
  • Experience is non-financial risk assessments associated with issues, events and change
  • Experience to senior stakeholder management, regulators and auditors interactions, where required
  • Focused, organised, results-oriented and works independently to strict timeframes
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

- Work closely with Compliance, Legal & Operational Risk teams to ensure deliverables are aligned with the latest requirements & regulations, and any exceptions are appropriately escalated, reported and managed
- Highlight risks to management and actively monitor them to reduce the likelihood of occurrence. - Help determine if there are any overlaps & inputs into other processes and/or risk registers
- Help ensure process risks are identified, escalated & tracked to resolution

- Act as liaison between the 2LoD and the various business or execution teams for effective and efficient process governance.
- Weighs up benefits of short term tactical and long-term strategic options to ensure solutions are delivered to the appropriate scale, scope and timing
- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
- Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. - Group Operational Risk

- Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Coverage Operations
- Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;

- Degree or diploma qualified with relevant experience in multiple phases of the programme and change management, preferably with exposure to business project delivery roles
- Knowledge of client onboarding, client lifecycle business areas aligned with corporate and commercial banking
- Knowledge of SCB standard processes, project management, implementation and post implementation process is an advantage

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Work with Product Owners, business users, operations, and technology teams to analyze business needs and translate them into clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Facilitate requirement walkthroughs, impact assessments, and solution discussions across business, technology, testing, risk, and control stakeholders.
  • Support Core Banking and Payments delivery by clarifying scope, managing requirement traceability, analyzing dependencies, resolving requirement queries, and ensuring delivery teams have a shared understanding of expected outcomes.
  • Partner with architects, developers, QA, DevOps, and support teams to ensure solutions are feasible, supportable, scalable, and aligned with operational and control expectations.
  • Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, release readiness, operational handover, and post-implementation review to ensure delivered solutions meet business needs.
  • Proactively identify requirement gaps, process issues, risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and drive timely clarification or resolution.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, data/interface requirements, decision records, and stakeholder updates.
  • Act as a trusted Senior Business Analyst for Core Banking and Payments stakeholders, bringing clarity, structure, and delivery focus to complex business and technology change.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years of experience in business analysis, technology delivery, product analysis, or banking system implementation, preferably in financial services.
  • Strong knowledge of Core Banking and Payments domains, including business flows, operational processes, system integration, transaction lifecycle, reconciliation, exception handling, and risk/control considerations.
  • Proven experience translating business needs into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, data/interface requirements, acceptance criteria, and impact assessments.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, testing lifecycle, release management, production support, and banking technology governance.
  • Experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, release readiness, operational handover, and post-implementation review.
  • Strong understanding of system integration, APIs, batch processing, file interfaces, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
  • Technical awareness of IBM iSeries/AS400, Java, Python, SQL, APIs, or enterprise banking platforms would be an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business, technology, operations, risk, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive ownership mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, control issues, and improvement opportunities early.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist (AI Gateway).

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Job Code: 52387

Location: Shenzhen / Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance the AI Gateway platform (design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain core services/integrations).
  • Responde to SRE alerts, triage incidents, mitigate issues, and drive recovery. Perform root-cause analysis and deliver preventive fixes/automation to improve reliability and reduce repeat incidents.
  • Respond to user queries, troubleshoot usage issues, and keep basic runbooks/FAQs up to date.

Requirements

  • Bachelor/Master degree in Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally with exposure to building or operating large-scale platform, infrastructure, or developer platform services.
  • Hands-on experience with API gateway and/or AI gateway patterns (for example: LLM/provider routing, policy enforcement, rate limiting, tenant isolation, authentication/authorisation, and observability). Experience with Kong API Gateway is strongly preferred; familiarity with Portkey-AI, APISIX, or Higress is a plus.
  • Strong programming skills in Golang or Python/Java, with solid fundamentals in concurrency and performance in distributed systems.
  • Experience with Golang, Lua, Nginx, OpenResty, and Kong is a plus, including custom plugin development, request/response transformations, traffic management, and performance tuning.
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes in enterprise environments, including ingress strategies (Nginx/Kong ingress), service networking, and workload optimisation for both stateful and stateless services.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud) and operating services in production (monitoring, alerting, incident response, and capacity planning).
  • Experience designing high-throughput, asynchronous systems using messaging queues and Pub/Sub technologies (for example: Kafka, RabbitMQ, cloud-native Pub/Sub).
  • Experience building LLM-enabled applications is a plus, including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG patterns, evaluation/monitoring, and integrating with model providers (for example: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source models).

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
  • Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • At least 10 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
  • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Strong focus on client servicing
  • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
  • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. ln:4470483944.descriptionHtml:
Ready to shape Corporate Sales growth for Strategic and Focus clients?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

Corporate Sales sits within HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) and supports corporate clients with relevant products, solutions and market insight. This role focuses on serving Strategic and Focus clients, building trusted relationships and improving product penetration and wallet share. You’ll manage revenue and profitability across an allocated client portfolio while delivering a high standard of service from idea through to execution and post-trade. The role also has a strong focus on improving the cost of service delivery including shifting transactional activity towards e-capability where appropriate. Where supervisory responsibilities apply, you’ll set direction for the local Corporate Sales team and maintain a strong control environment across front office activity. Success means measurable portfolio growth, strong client feedback and consistent delivery in line with HSBC policies and regulatory expectations.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage a portfolio of Strategic and Focus corporate clients with clear ownership of revenue performance
  • Identify sales opportunities end-to-end from client need through execution and post-trade support
  • Provide day-to-day coverage across the Corporate Sales offering, coordinating with trading teams to support execution flow
  • Develop client relationships that strengthen product penetration and expand share of wallet across priority accounts
  • Partner with Relationship Managers, Global Payments Solutions (GPS) and Global Trade Solutions (GTS) to meet client needs
  • Champion adoption of appropriate service models such as migrating transactional activity to self-service e-capability
  • Coordinate with Corporate Risk Solutions (CRS) for complex balance sheet structuring solutions and cross-sell opportunities
  • Maintain an effective control environment, escalating unusual or unacceptable activity and supporting fair customer outcomes
  • Oversee team activity where supervisory responsibilities apply including performance management, coaching and resource planning
  • Adapt processes as technology platforms evolve while keeping service quality and risk controls front of mind

What We're Looking For

  • Bring strong experience in Corporate Sales including knowledge of products, clients, systems and key processes
  • Apply established understanding of capital markets including foreign exchange instruments and interest rate derivatives
  • Manage transaction flow from order through to execution in partnership with trading teams and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrate a track record of developing client relationships that translate into revenue growth and deeper product usage
  • Partner effectively across teams and regions to deliver coordinated client coverage and consistent service
  • Operate within regulatory requirements for non-advisory sales and trading activities including holding relevant local or cross-border exams and qualifications or equivalent demonstrable experience
  • Apply sound judgement in managing conduct risk, financial crime risk and operational risk within a front office environment
  • Supervise and develop team members where applicable including performance management, coaching and maintaining quality of output

Building deeper Corporate Sales relationships

This role offers the chance to shape how HSBC supports Strategic and Focus corporate clients across products, execution and service models. You’ll be central to improving client outcomes while strengthening revenue performance and operational efficiency. Where supervisory responsibilities apply, you’ll also create clarity on standards and controls and support a consistent approach to front office supervision.

If you want your work to be measured in client trust, disciplined execution and sustainable growth this role is a strong platform to build from. Apply to help expand the HSBC Corporate Sales franchise through relationships that last and solutions that land well in market.
